decision_rule.structural_controls: all four (future immutability bitwise, newest-bar sensitivity, time reversal, save/load) must PASS — unchanged, already accepted
decision_rule.synthetic_predictive_gate: per family: paired difference DeltaR2 = pretrained - control computed over 4 signal seeds for EACH control (4-seed random encoders averaged per signal seed, within-window permutation, per-window phase scramble, order-invariant pooled baseline); gate requires for EVERY informative control: mean(DeltaR2) >= 0.05 (predeclared minimum practical effect) AND t-based 95% CI lower bound > 0 over the 4 paired differences
decision_rule.phase_control: per-window random circular shift destroys the stable phase->target relation while preserving per-window amplitude content; the target (next bar of the periodic channel) is phase-dependent BY CONSTRUCTION, so this control is IN the decision rule; if a family's random-encoder ceiling saturates (R2 >= 0.95) the family is CEILING_SATURATED_INCONCLUSIVE for the synthetic gate
decision_rule.sample_target_identity: within-window permutation preserves each window's target and value multiset; IDENTICAL chronological train/validation indices for every treatment; the old global permutation is retained ONLY as global_sample_misalignment_negative and is NOT in the decision rule
decision_rule.real_data_gate: per family AND fused: causal ridge probes for quantile (0.1/0.5/0.9 pinball), realized volatility (R2) and barrier hit (accuracy vs base rate) with ISOLATED chronological roles fit/calibration/monitor (ridge lambda selected ONLY on calibration; scored ONLY on monitor); a probe is informative when the pretrained embedding beats BOTH the 4-seed random-encoder mean and the within-window shuffled control by the same predeclared margin (>= 0.02 absolute on the probe's scale) on the monitor role
decision_rule.lag_memory: chronological out-of-sample (fit 70 early / score 30 late), ridge on fit only, vs naive last-bar (autoregressive) baseline, random encoder and within-window shuffled controls; in-sample fits are dead

classification: REPRESENTATION_DIAGNOSTIC only — no economic or promotion authority; verdict vocabulary: PASS / FAIL / CEILING_SATURATED_INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_INFORMATIVE
